closure_notice.title: The closure notice
closure_notice.text: No. 2 Working is closed for a roof collapse on the lower level, by order of the site office. Someone has scratched NOTIFIED WHEN? underneath.

early_recall.title: Pulled at the half
early_recall.text: The lower-level crew was ordered out mid-shift, before any collapse was reported. A driller who was there heard nothing from the rock.

power_cut.title: A dark yard
power_cut.text: The upper yard lost all power on the night of the collapse. By morning the mine door was the way it is now. Nobody passed the gate in between.

sealed_outside.title: Welded from outside
sealed_outside.text: The mine door is welded shut on the outside, the bead still bright. Rescue stretchers sit beside it, never unwrapped.
